description:
Review uncommitted vault changes, then stage and commit all of them to git.

Subcommands:
  review [--max-file-lines N] [--max-lines N] — print every change since the last commit; read-only
  save --message SUBJECT [--body TEXT] [--dry-run] — stage every vault change and commit

Flags:
  review:
    --max-file-lines N  diff lines shown per file; default 150
    --max-lines N  total output lines; default 3000
  save:
    --message SUBJECT  required; single line; non-empty
    --body TEXT  commit body; may span multiple lines
    --dry-run  report what would be staged and committed; change nothing

Examples:
  ["review"]
  ["save", "--message", "Log SGB kickoff meeting and flush buffer", "--body", "New meeting note, two actions ingested, 3h logged."]
  ["save", "--message", "Record October payments", "--dry-run"]

Notes:
  Run review first, write the summary from its output, then save.
  save stages everything in the vault, not selected files. It only adds a commit; it never amends, resets or pushes.
  Exit 1: empty or multi-line --message; vault not a git repository or not the repository root; git add or commit failed.
